facts.fact: On January 31, 2023, StackAdapt announced a partnership with Snowflake to launch a new 1st-party data activation integration on Snowflake Marketplace.
facts.quote: today announced it has partnered with Snowflake, the Data Cloud company, to launch a new 1st-party data activation integration on Snowflake Marketplace.

facts.fact: The StackAdapt and Snowflake integration lets joint customers activate 1st-party data via a share to the StackAdapt Snow account.
facts.quote: The new activation integration seamlessly enables joint customers to activate 1st-party data via a share to the StackAdapt Snow account.

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt's own description, its self-serve programmatic advertising platform is used by hundreds of brands and agencies around the world.
facts.quote: StackAdapt is a self-serve programmatic advertising platform used by hundreds of brands and agencies around the world.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states it is rated the number 1 demand-side platform (DSP) on G2, a third-party review site.
facts.quote: is rated [the number 1 demand-side platform](https://www.stackadapt.com/best-demand-side-platform-dsp) (DSP) on G2

facts.fact: StackAdapt's Snowflake integration transfers data into StackAdapt's custom segment generation pipeline to activate audiences across all biddable media channels and environments.
facts.quote: transferring data into StackAdapt’s custom segment generation pipeline to activate audiences across all biddable media channels and environments through StackAdapt.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's Director of Corporate Development and Channel Partnerships, Ben Brodie, said increasing compliance requirements such as GDPR are a reason StackAdapt is providing first-party data campaign capabilities.
facts.quote: With increasing compliance requirements across the globe like GDPR, StackAdapt is providing first-party data campaign capabilities,

facts.fact: Snowflake Marketplace is powered by Snowflake's cross-cloud technology, Snowgrid.
facts.quote: Snowflake Marketplace is powered by Snowflake’s ground-breaking cross-cloud technology, Snowgrid,
